decision_scope: For repository github.com/zycaskevin/agentic-sdd-governance and trust domain agentic-sdd-governance-owner-2026q3, activate only the fail-closed R22 scoped Local-Green rule described in work-packages/DEC-R22-SCOPED-LOCAL-GATE-001.md and docs/R22_SCOPED_VALIDATION.md: skip R22 only for a trusted Base-bound exact non-empty canonical change set containing no R22-protected path; require R22 for missing, malformed, ambiguous, candidate-supplied, or protected change data; and treat the classifier, Gate contract, decision record, R22 authority inputs, Owner-client source chain, trust data, and packaged governance resources as protected.

decision_package.why_human_input_is_required: Changing when an Owner-authority verification is required changes the public security-policy contract and cannot be authorized by the candidate itself.
what_agent_already_verified: The current Local Green contract invokes R22 unconditionally.
The offline classifier fails closed for missing, empty, malformed, and protected path inputs.
The targeted R22 scope, CI Guard, and repository-contract tests passed without changing the active Gate.
No production action, credential, key, trust-store, deployment, or network operation is in scope.

options.label: A
options.description: Activate the exact fail-closed scoped Local-Green rule bound by the listed assumptions.

options.label: B
options.description: Keep unconditional R22 validation for every Local-Green invocation.

decision_package.why: It unblocks unrelated offline work such as AF27 while retaining R22 validation for every authority-bearing change and every uncertain change set.
decision_package.impact_if_no_decision: AF27 and other unrelated changes remain blocked by the unconditional R22 Local-Green command.
